title: Sheinbaum Foresees 12 Million Families Benefited by the Housing Program by the End of Her Government
author: Emir Olivares and Lilian Hernández
content:
_This article by Emir Olivares and Lilian Hernández originally appeared in
the[September 14, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/09/14/politica/sheinbaum-
preve-que-al-final-de-su-gobierno-haya-12-millones-de-familias-beneficiadas-
con-programa-de-vivienda), Mexico's premier left-wing daily newspaper._

**Mexico City**. President Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo asserted that by the end of
her six-year term, **12 million families will be benefited by the housing
program** , which will generate an annual economic spillover of 1.2 percent of
GDP.

At this Monday's press conference, she highlighted that this government's goal
is to build 1.8 million new homes, restructure 1.8 million loans for home
improvement, restructure 5.1 million loans, issue one million property deeds,
as well as provide 2.2 million traditional loans.

"It's about 1.2 percent of GDP per year in economic spillover from the
housing-for-well-being program; 12 million families are going to be benefited
by the entire housing program over the six-year term."

She emphasized that **each home generates an average of four jobs**. "Six
hundred thousand homes have already been contracted (to date); that's 2.4
million jobs associated with the homes that were contracted."

> The most important thing is having access to what we consider a right, which
> is decent housing.

For her part, the head of Sedatu, Edna Vega, stated that for now the states
where the most social-interest housing has been built are Tabasco, Quintana
Roo, Yucatán, Tamaulipas, and Veracruz.

The official stated that **667,000 homes have been contracted, representing 37
percent progress** toward the total of 1.8 million. So far, the accumulated
investment is 75.9 billion pesos.
